test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Ambiguous
solution: The correct answer is **option 4 i.e. Certain.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Ambiguous **means doubtful or uncertain especially from obscurity or indistinctness. (अस्पष्ट; अनेकार्थता) • **For Example:** • **​***His reply to my question was somewhat **ambiguous**.* • *​***Certain **means completely sure; without any doubts.( अवश्‍यंभावी; निश्चित, पक्‍का, सुस्‍पष्‍ट) • **For Example:** • **​***She’s absolutely **certain **that there was somebody outside her window.* • *​Thus,* **Certain **and **Ambiguous **is opposite to each other. • Hence the correct answer is **option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Annoying **means making you feel angry or slightly angry.(कष्‍टकर, कष्‍टप्रद; खीझ पैदा करने वाला) • **Stylish **means fashionable and attractive.(फै़शनेबल और आकर्षक) • **Sensational **means causing, or trying to cause, a feeling of great excitement, surprise or interest among people.(सनसनीख़ेज़ (सनसनी पैदा करने या पैदा करने की कोशिश करते हुए)) 4e:Ta7e, The correct answer is **option 2 i.e. Queer**
